This is a technique to knock you out without drugs or anything. You have to bend your  knees and take 10 deep breaths through your nose by the 10 breath take a deep breath through your nose and stand up straight against a wall, keep the breath in your lungs and let someone push your chest hard. If you did it correctly you should pass out for about 3 seconds.
